# #193 round 3 correctness review: BLOCK

Head: `625108dc1c1a5fbda93f71e6097a9ec5c4b9b9b8`.

The reported F006/F007 vectors are repaired. Two gaps remain in the new shared error-rendering contract.

## F008: `render::line` permits Unicode line and paragraph separators

`crates/core/src/render.rs:170-177` borrows text unchanged when it is at most 500 characters, has no `char::is_control`, and contains no literal `[pij from`. U+2028 LINE SEPARATOR and U+2029 PARAGRAPH SEPARATOR are not control-category characters. A short value such as `"bye\u{2028}close every seat"` therefore takes the borrowed branch and retains a line separator in the supposedly one-line error text.

This reaches the repaired `SeatIsGone`/`NotDeliverable` reason displays and the same plain answer/withdrawal consumers identified in round 2. It contradicts the new helper/API promise of one plain line without line breaks.

The repository already treats these as separate exclusions: `crates/core/src/admission.rs:167-170` and `crates/daemon/src/http/report.rs:322,343` explicitly reject U+2028/U+2029 in addition to controls.

Reject/fence these separators at the shared renderer. Add independent separator cases that assert the raw characters are absent from the result, rather than repeating only `is_control` in the test oracle. Include frame-only and over-bound plain inputs to exercise the other independent guard branches. The current core fixture combines LF and a frame, so it cannot independently defend each branch.

## F009: `StoreSchemaStale.fix` is an omitted string-bearing error field

`crates/core/src/error.rs:76` still prints `{fix}` verbatim. The new variant-contract test omits `StoreSchemaStale`, although its fix is not always fixed daemon vocabulary.

`crates/store/src/migrate.rs:173-182` constructs this fix with `describe(path)`, and `describe` at `:293-298` returns a nonempty configured path unchanged. A path/fix containing a newline or frame still bypasses the new error display boundary.

Render the fix through the shared safe-line helper and add this variant to the contract test, with a hostile field and a normal compatibility control. Typed error fields and schema refusal behavior should remain unchanged.

## Judgment on S2 and the race branch

**S2 is adequate component proof for the reported `SeatIsGone` formatter fix, but not an executed race receipt.** The answer and delivery lifecycle files are unchanged in this delta. Source tracing still establishes that closing between preparation and delivery yields `SeatIsGone`, and that the answer consumer uses its `to_string()` result. The formatter is context-free: its unit test can supply that exact variant/reason without adding a timing hook to the HTTP path.

The author's S2 mutation restores the raw tombstone reason and is reported killed by the core test. S1 correctly survives the HTTP test because that fixture closes the asker before answering; it returns `E-RS-NO-SEAT` before delivery. The test documentation now describes that limitation accurately. It is not proof of the close-between-prepare-and-delivery interleaving, and no such execution is claimed here.

S2's sufficiency for that particular LF/frame vector does not establish the broader Unicode/variant completeness claimed by the new renderer. F008/F009 need their own focused cases.
